classification: Exploratory emulated Linux x86_64 red diagnostic; not native Linux x64 qualification or a passing test

finding.cause: The Python peer inherited a signal mask blocking SIGTERM. The owner requested SIGTERM; the signal remained pending and blocked, so waitUntilExit did not finish.
finding.syntheticCommandAttribution: This focused reproduction selects the transport chunk-control test, and its blocked stack belongs to transport peer teardown. It does not demonstrate a synthetic command handler, router, responder, or statistics hang.

scope.baselineExecutable: Already-compiled baseline executable; source tests modified by root were not rebuilt for this diagnostic
scope.debuggerReceiptStatusMeaning: The debugger command returned zero. The deliberately killed test did not pass.

signalEvidence.interpretation: Linux /proc signal masks use bit signalNumber-1. Both SigBlk and ShdPnd contain 0x4000, while SigPnd is zero. SIGTERM is pending at process level and blocked for delivery.
signalEvidence.timestampPrecision: UTC observation times are derived from the driver wall-clock start plus rounded monotonic offsets; snapshot offsets are authoritative.

frames.symbol: partial apply forwarder for closure #2 () -> () in Foundation.Process.waitUntilExit() -> ()

swiftStack.otherThreads: libdispatch signal/event loop; Foundation Process setup run loop; CF socket manager

diagnosticIsolation.remoteDebugEnvironment: ROSETTA_DEBUGSERVER_PORT applied only to the final test executable. At its initial ELF stop, one byte of that environment key was renamed to _OSETTA_DEBUGSERVER_PORT; envp/auxv pointers stayed unchanged and no inferior function was evaluated.
diagnosticIsolation.stackModuleAddresses: x86_64 ELF module paths and load addresses loaded from the owned test process maps before backtrace
diagnosticIsolation.limitations: Rosetta remote debugging and module reconstruction are exploratory. Ordinary ptrace probes produced unusable register stacks. No hosted or native x64 validation is implied.

repairReadOnlyReview.ordering: Installs the existing SIGTERM handler, conditionally unblocks only SIGTERM via pthread_sigmask, then publishes readiness. Other inherited masks stay unchanged.
repairReadOnlyReview.regressionScope: Masked and unmasked single-threaded exec launchers; bounded startup/read/termination; exact 65536-byte payload and final metrics; graceful exit before forced cleanup; child reaping and listener closure.
repairReadOnlyReview.validationBoundary: This is a code review. Root owns the subsequent green build/test attempt; this subagent ran no further native tests.
